tasks.name: wipe-r4-20261025-recovery-r1
tasks.summary:
One new **P2 bug reproduced**: French curses users cannot confirm shutdown without saving.

[console_wizard.py:1945](C:/Users/Jack/beamo-release-work/20261024-wipe-audit-pass2/src/beamo_wipe/ui/console_wizard.py:1945) decodes input as ASCII, then compares it with `ÉTEINDRE SANS ENREGISTRER`. The accented character becomes replacement text, so the exact advertised phrase is rejected and the session stays open.

Exact-AST probes reproduced the failure. **Eight adjacent controls and 30 additional controller controls passed**, including French plain-console confirmation, English/German curses confirmation, stale generations, stop ownership, and retry guards.

A separate documentation discrepancy remains: EOF permits shutdown when no report was requested, contrary to wording in `report-shutdown.md`; existing tests explicitly expect that behavior. No new shutdown-safety defect is claimed.

[Review and evidence](C:/Users/Jack/beamo-release-evidence/wipe-comprehensive-repass-20261025-r4/recovery-review/review-summary.json) include traces, hashes, withdrawn hypotheses, and setup failures.

tasks.name: wipe-r4-20261025-build-r1
tasks.summary:
One new **P2 finding**: [generate-release-manifest.sh:131](/C:/Users/Jack/beamo-release-work/20261024-wipe-audit-pass2/scripts/generate-release-manifest.sh:131) can silently discard a concurrent foreign `SHA256SUMS` file.

The earlier ownership check accepts an absent destination. If another writer then creates a regular file there, the final publisher checks only type/UID and calls `os.replace`, losing that object without retaining it. Exact-AST in-memory probes reproduced this both after preflight and after the final metadata check.

Four adjacent controls behaved correctly: absent output publishes; a foreign file present at preflight, a directory, and a symlink are refused. Twelve additional receipt/JUnit controls also behaved as expected.

All **80 scoped input hashes remained unchanged**, matching preflight. No additional concrete new defect was established. The whole 922-input census was not recomputed.

[Full handoff and evidence](/C:/Users/Jack/beamo-release-evidence/wipe-comprehensive-repass-20261025-r4/build-review/RESULT.md) includes traces, reproducible probe scripts, hashes, withdrawn hypotheses, and pending root validation.

tasks.name: wipe-r4-20261025-full-containment-review-r1
tasks.summary:
**Full gate remains BLOCKED.** Latest reported capacity is **4,409,245,696 bytes free on C:** and **997,507,072 bytes available RAM**, below the unchanged admission floors. No further tests are justified; resource cause remains unknown.

The parent’s observer exited 0 with `observations[]` and `same_uid_inaccessible[]`, without signals. This establishes only that no matching namespace holders were observed. It does not prove universal descendant cleanup or explain the capacity loss.

A future PID namespace can close the `setsid()`/double-fork lifetime gap, provided its init’s termination is positively controlled. [Linux PID namespace documentation](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/pid_namespaces.7.html). Admission additionally requires:

- Private `/proc`, a reaping PID-1 supervisor, checked startup/lifelines and bounded owned teardown.
- Exclusion of inherited service sockets, Windows interop paths and physical devices.
- Proved aggregate resource limits and bounded writable storage/log transport.
- Unchanged gate assertions, skips and internal timeouts, bound to current identity `fc2d15fdfeebe3aa9d3352f752bf5f1dba0d7deff34042e223b879d2212b829b`.
- Successful finite inert selftests covering escape, cancellation, owner loss, setup refusal, resource limits and evidence failures.

The [durable review and ten-case acceptance checklist](/C:/Users/Jack/beamo-release-evidence/wipe-comprehensive-repass-20261025-r4/full-containment-review/review.md) contains the concrete design, limitations and remaining-work checkpoint.
